headline: Building tools for better flow
narrative: Quiet week in Stockholm, focused on cursor-commands and shipflow. Coding activity is down slightly but the work is intentional—refining developer tools that make building software easier. The music shifts between dream pop and trip hop, exploring new sounds while staying grounded in familiar favorites. Winter's short days and overcast skies create the perfect backdrop for deep work.

sections.content: Heads-down on developer tooling, with focused work on cursor-commands and shipflow.
